description: Source code for E2 connection handler managing E2AP message forwarding, connection lifecycle, and TNL association in a 5G network component.

classes.name: e2_rx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward E2AP Rx PDUs from E2 GW to E2 Agent, signals connection loss on destruction.

classes.name: e2_tx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward E2AP Tx PDUs to E2 GW, manages lifetime of TNL connection.

classes.name: e2_connection_handler
classes.description: Handles E2 connection lifecycle, message forwarding, and TNL association management.

methods.name: connect_to_ric
methods.description: Establishes connection to RIC, sets up message notifiers, and returns a notifier for E2 messages.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, dispatches cleanup to the E2AP executor.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss_impl
methods.description: Performs actual cleanup of connection state and signals disconnection.

methods.name: handle_tnl_association_removal
methods.description: Asynchronously handles removal of TNL association, ensuring proper disconnection procedures.
